build_LearnedPosition: build a LearnedPosition module that adds learned positional encodings to a 3D tensor input
build_StartSym: build a StartSym module that prefixes a sequence tensor with a learned start symbol
build_TransformerBlock: build a TransformerBlock with self-attention and cross-attention for encoder or decoder use
build_Transformer: build a Transformer stack of configurable transformer blocks for encoding or decoding sequences
build_EncoderSection: build an EncoderSection transformer encoder with no look-ahead masking for sequence encoding
